registers.name: GICR_PENDBASER
registers.fullName: Redistributor LPI Pending Table Base Address Register
registers.description: Redistributor LPI Pending Table Base Address Register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: PTZ
fields.description: Pending Table Zero. Indicates to the Redistributor whether the LPI Pending 表 is zero when GICR_CTLR.EnableLPIs == 1. 此字段为只写 (WO)，读返回 0。 [0b0=The LPI Pending 表 is not zero, and contains live data. ; 0b1=The LPI Pending 表 is zero. Software must ensure the LPI ]

fields.name: OuterCache
fields.description: 指示 Outer Cacheability attributes of 访问 to the LPI Pending 表. 此字段是固定值还是可由软件编程是 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。 以固定值实现此字段已弃用。 [0b000=内存类型由 InnerCache 字段定义. For Normal memory, ; 0b001=Normal Outer Non-cacheable. ; 0b010=Normal Outer Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-through。 ; 0b011=Normal Outer Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-back。 ; 0b100=Normal Outer Cacheable, Write-allocate, Write-through。 ; 0b101=Normal Outer Cacheable, Write-allocate, Write-back。 ; 0b110=Normal Outer Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-allocate, W ; 0b111=Normal Outer Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-allocate, W]

fields.name: Physical_Address
fields.description: Bits [51:16] of the 物理地址 containing the LPI Pending 表. 在支持少于 52 位物理地址的实现中，未实现的高位为 RES0。

fields.name: Shareability
fields.description: 指示 Shareability attributes of 访问 to the LPI Pending 表. 此字段是固定值还是可由软件编程是 IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED。 以固定值实现此字段已弃用。 [0b00=Non-shareable. ; 0b01=Inner Shareable. ; 0b10=Outer Shareable. ; 0b11=保留. Treated as 0b00.]

fields.name: InnerCache
fields.description: 指示 Inner Cacheability attributes of 访问 to the LPI Pending 表. [0b000=Device-nGnRnE. ; 0b001=Normal Inner Non-cacheable. ; 0b010=Normal Inner Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-through。 ; 0b011=Normal Inner Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-back。 ; 0b100=Normal Inner Cacheable, Write-allocate, Write-through。 ; 0b101=Normal Inner Cacheable, Write-allocate, Write-back。 ; 0b110=Normal Inner Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-allocate, W ; 0b111=Normal Inner Cacheable, Read-allocate, Write-allocate, W]
